hp.label: HP
hp.name: Health
hp.description: Maximum health before incapacitation. Current HP can fall without reducing this maximum.

mp.label: MP
mp.name: Magick Points
mp.description: Maximum energy available for abilities that cost MP. More MP supports more casting, without increasing spell power.

str.label: Str
str.name: Strength
str.description: Increases the power of physical attacks and strength-based techniques.

mag.label: Mag
mag.name: Magick
mag.description: Increases the power of damaging spells. Healing spell power comes from Spirit.

spr.label: Spr
spr.name: Spirit
spr.description: Increases the power of healing spells. Damaging spell power comes from Magick.

m_def.label: M. Def
m_def.name: Magick Defense
m_def.description: Reduces incoming magical damage. Specific status resistances are separate properties.

speed.label: Speed
speed.name: Speed
speed.description: Determines when a character acts in combat. It does not change exploration walking or running speed.

acc.label: Acc
acc.name: Accuracy
acc.description: Improves the chance to land attacks that check accuracy. This rating is not a hit percentage.

eva.label: Eva
eva.name: Evasion
eva.description: Improves the chance to avoid attacks that can be evaded. This rating is not an evasion percentage.

lck.label: Lck
lck.name: Luck
lck.description: Improves critical-hit chance for attacks that can critically hit. This rating is not a critical-hit percentage.
